component.name: Pipsqueak
component.summary: Mirror a monitor in a small floating window

description.p: Pipsqueak shows a live picture-in-picture mirror of one of your monitors in a small, borderless, always-floating window - handy for keeping an eye on a second screen without dedicating a whole monitor or workspace to it.

Uses the ScreenCast portal, so it works the same under any Wayland compositor's screen-sharing permission flow. Resize with +/- (a handful of fixed presets, not free drag-resize - that's what keeps it floating instead of getting tiled by tiling window managers). Press Tab to pick a different monitor.
